findings.finding: Nothing says a child inherits the root's acceptance with its own key substituted; the root bullets name LEGSMOKE-1190 literally and the child spec is empty.
findings.answer: plan.md section 1 and D2: every LEGSMOKE-1190 in the root Acceptance reads as LEGSMOKE-1193 for this child (PATH smoke/LEGSMOKE-1193.md, .legion/LEGSMOKE-1193/, the line's key), with the reasons; recorded as one specDepartures entry (outcome unchanged, the child spec being empty) and named in the completion summary for the architect.

findings.finding: 'On the branch's first push' is literally false: the branch's first push is this plan's handoff, which carries no marker.
findings.answer: plan.md section 5: H = firstCodeHead, the first pushed commit carrying PATH, recorded in implement.json and the E2E (implementer) line; AC1 binds to ?ref=$H, never to the branch name; tester and reviewer re-run at the same recorded SHA.

findings.finding: No bullet says which phase proves which criterion or at which head it first becomes provable.
findings.answer: plan.md section 5 table: AC1/AC2/AC4 implementer at H (tester re-runs); AC3 tester and reviewer read at the CI head; AC5 implementer at H2 in the round answering the review; AC6 retro locally and merger before READY; AC7 the implementer's production check at M and main after the close.

findings.finding: 'Both workflows pass on the pull request's head' names neither the head nor what pass means when only gate is required.
findings.answer: plan.md AC3 and D5: CI head from actions/runs?event=pull_request, check-runs at that SHA, pass when every gate and every check run is completed/success; only a red gate blocks the merge and is sent back by the daemon; a red check is a REQUEST_CHANGES under the spec's words, re-run once by the implementer, never by a push; READY is judged on retro's head, the last code head.

findings.finding: The optional one-line append names no machine-readable trigger and no text for the second line.
findings.answer: plan.md AC5 and D3: trigger is a CHANGES_REQUESTED review by Legion's reviewer asking for the line; L2 is the review's text, else the precedent 'Legion proof review round 1 (LEGSMOKE)'; the implementer never appends without such a review and at most once; constantsRebound (L2, bytes, sha256, H2) recorded; checks wc -l 2, head -1 == L1, sed -n 2p == L2; AC1 at H stands.

findings.finding: The spec pins the file only with wc -l = 1, which CRLF, BOM or trailing spaces also satisfy, while the plan's byte constants are tighter.
findings.answer: plan.md section 2: the byte set (85 bytes, last byte 0a, first bytes 4c 45 47, zero 0d, sha256) is a deliberate tightening per the LEGSMOKE-1021 note; file produced with printf '%s\n'; the derivation commands are recorded and the implementer recomputes rather than trusts them.

findings.finding: The changed-files criterion is true at no single head and its 'files under docs/solutions/' clause may be unsatisfiable if retro writes no note.
findings.answer: plan.md AC2 (filtered compare from F at each head; Size: line from the same set) and AC6/D4 (pulls/<n>/files lists the marker plus zero or one docs/solutions/legion/*-LEGSMOKE-1193.md and no .legion/ path; 'files under docs/solutions/' read as zero or more); AC7 reads the merge commit's files.

findings.finding: Every proof entry needs a negativeControl, the spec supplies none, and the ?ref=main control inverts after the merge.
findings.answer: plan.md section 5 'Negative controls': 404 at ?ref=main (pre-merge) and at ?ref=F, 404 for altered paths and a wrong SHA, SHA_ALT/CRLF/no-LF digest mismatches, BLOCKED/0 check-runs at a trailered handoff head; all read-only; .fail-me forbidden for every phase; after the merge the F control and the altered string remain.

findings.finding: The recorded 'branch tip == main@origin' is a live reading, and nothing says which facts are stop conditions.
findings.answer: plan.md section 4: P1-P4 are the only invalidating facts; the base tip's SHA is not a fact; F recorded once for every compare and fork-point control; compare/F...<sha> status 'ahead' is the branch invariant.

findings.finding: The post-merge read from main is the implementer's production check, and nothing says what counts as production carrying the merge for a repository with no deploy.
findings.answer: plan.md AC7: production is sjawhar/legion-smoke@main; the check reads commits/<M> files and the contents at ?ref=M and ?ref=main; the M read decides; pass as soon as M is read and matches; fail per findings.md; pending is never this repository's answer once M exists.

findings.finding: The tester must try to break a surface that has no input, and no bounded set of break attempts is named.
findings.answer: plan.md Tester step 3 enumerates the permitted attempts (altered paths, wrong refs, altered digests, JSON route at a handoff head, second read, BLOCKED/0 at the handoff head) and states they exhaust the budget; .fail-me, workspace writes outside test.json, CI re-runs and pushes are prohibited for the tester.
